messages:
sana (product): Quick sync request — PharmaPilot (pilot customer) wants a compact Optimize alpha: tenant-aware quant suggestions, nightly eval-triggered alerts on a curated clinical prompt set, and a non-automated recommendation flow. Need to confirm scope we can commit to for their pilot starting in 4 weeks.

mike (swe): Clarify deployment: theyre on Dedicated in eu-west right now, might need Private later. For alpha we can target Dedicated only to keep infra surface small.

leila (ml): For quant suggestions my rough flow: sample 2k prompts from their corpus -> run baseline model + candidate quant variants -> compute delta on token-level perplexity and a domain-specific scorer (we have a clinical name-entity F1 hook) -> rank flavors by tradeoff. Output top-2 with estimated p50/p95/p99 latency and expected cost delta.

sana (product): Nice. They also want eval-triggered alerts: when nightly eval shows degradation beyond threshold, alert ops + their designated Slack webhook and record audit entry. They explicitly said: "no automatic quant rollouts".

omar (solutions): Customer requires an auditable decision record for any suggestion delivered to them. We need to record baseline eval hash, new eval artifacts, recommended quant tag, and the user-facing rationale.

mike (swe): Engineering constraints: reuse eval-runner + telemetry pipeline. Need tenant config flags and small rule engine to compare metrics. UI would be nice but low priority; propose API + JSON delivery in alpha. Implementation estimate: 2 sprints (1 SWE + 0.5 SRE) if API-only.

leila (ml): Alpha thresholds proposal:
- primary metric: clinical-entity F1 drop > 2% absolute OR
- secondary: perplexity increase > 8% AND p99 latency reduction > 20% yields a candidate suggestion
If any trigger, publish alert with payload.

sana (product): Proposed acceptance criteria for Alpha:
- nightly eval runs for tenant and saves metrics to central store (exists + queryable)
- when trigger fires, an alert event is produced within 10 minutes and delivered to (a) internal ops channel, (b) customer webhook, and (c) email list
- audit log entry persisted with baseline_eval_id, new_eval_id, recommended_quant, metric_deltas, and run_id
- explicit opt-out config per tenant prevents suggestions from being delivered
- docs + one-page runbook for on-call and customer success

omar (solutions): We'll need a short paragraph for the contract: "alpha recommendations are advisory only; no changes will be auto-applied without explicit customer acceptance." I'll draft.

mike (swe): Delivery format (API):
```json
{
  "tenant": "pharmapilot",
  "eval_ts": "2025-02-15T02:00:00Z",
  "metric_deltas": {"entity_f1": -0.03, "ppl": 0.09},
  "recommended_quant": "q4_8x",
  "est_latency_ms": {"p50": 30, "p95": 55, "p99": 78}
}
```
Note: the literal JSON above will live in the alert payload.

leila (ml): Good. We'll also attach a short rationale string (2-3 sentences) explaining the observed failure modes and why the quant is expected to help cost/latency.

sana (product): Prioritization ask: customers with compliance needs get priority for alpha slots. PharmaPilot is approved as anchor. Approve alpha scope (API-only, no UI, audit log, opt-out, nightly evals + alerts)? React with :white_check_mark: / :x:.

mike (swe): :white_check_mark: — eng can deliver API-only alpha in ~3 weeks with focused sprinting.

leila (ml): :white_check_mark: — ML will prepare eval set and candidate quant matrix.

omar (solutions): :white_check_mark: — I'll prep customer comms + acceptance checklist.

ci-bot: Created branch feature/optimize-pharmapilot-alpha and started CI pipeline.

sana (product): Next steps:
- Mike: open engineering ticket with acceptance criteria + infra deps (today)
- Leila: upload eval set + candidate quant runs to S3 + share baseline hashes (48h)
- Omar: draft customer onboarding note and opt-out language (EOD tomorrow)
- Sana: schedule 30m kickoff with PharmaPilot for scope alignment (next Tue)

sana (product): If anyone objects to alpha scope, flag now. Otherwise I'll mark this thread for action and spin up the tickets.
